sloka: अभिवाद्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं तांश्च सर्वांस्तपोधनान् ।अध्यारोहत्तदव्यग्रः पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम् ।। ७.८२.१५ ॥
transliteration: abhivādya muniśreṣṭhaṁ tāṁśca sarvāṁstapodhanān ।adhyārohattadavyagraḥ puṣpakaṁ hemabhūṣitam ।। 7.82.15 ॥

translations.english: Having saluted the best of sages and all those ascetics, he then calmly ascended the Pushpaka chariot, which was adorned with gold.
